scope: Whole necklace, both sides: camera/2704 transforms/materials/pattern/helicity unchanged. All measurements outside conservative photo band and exact model silhouette. Normalized linear-light paper profiles, never bead color or bead-shadow labels.
feature_definition: Strong photographic peak>=30% and both trailing crossings observed; 10% absolute toe is primary; 5% toe is sensitive to background error. Penumbra is sustained90..10% falloff of observed whole-necklace shadow peak, not a single-bead PSF. Distances remain original-photo pixels.
background_sensitivity: Full per-profile features retained for background level +/-3%; these are nuisance sensitivity controls, not confidence intervals.

R345.reference: Smooth photographic background, evaluated only on far-from-necklace grid points; shader paper albedo unchanged.

R346.reference: Smooth photographic background, evaluated only on far-from-necklace grid points; shader paper albedo unchanged.
